metadata.title: PISA for Development Assessment and Analytical Framework (EN)

extraction.outcome_summary: The OECD publication described the PISA for Development (PISA-D) assessment and analytical framework for reading, mathematics, and science, including how it extends the PISA 2012/2015 frameworks to better measure lower proficiency levels in middle- and low-income countries. It outlined the school-based and out-of-school components, the rationale for targeted instruments and reduced reading burden, and the contextual questionnaire framework (including the Education Prosperity model). The report focused on assessment design, reporting scales, and implementation/capacity-building rather than on fitting statistical or ML models to estimate effects.
